intro: Designed for modern workspaces, Enterprise is a seamless blend of practicality and elegance. Its sturdy wood-and-steel build ensures durability, while thoughtful features keep you organised and comfortable.

features.title: Tidy up with built-in wire management
features.text: No more messy cables! Neatly placed wire slots keep cords out of sight, giving your workspace a clean, clutter-free look.

features.title: Smart storage that works for you
features.text: A built-in pedestal with spacious drawers ensures all your work essentials—files, stationery, and personal items—are within arm’s reach.

features.title: One lock for total security
features.text: With a single lock securing all three drawers, you can keep your confidential documents safe with ease.

features.title: Smooth, effortless drawer access
features.text: Snap-fit plastic grips make opening and closing drawers hassle-free, ensuring a smooth workflow throughout the day.

features.title: Comfort meets functionality
features.text: With single-side storage, you get plenty of legroom to stretch and work comfortably, making long hours at your desk much easier.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
